iPhone

Mac

Mac net sales increased during 2025 compared to 2024 primarily due to higher net sales of laptops and desktops.


iPad

iPad net sales increased during 2025 compared to 2024 primarily due to higher net sales of iPad Air, iPad mini and iPad, partially
offset by lower net sales of iPad Pro.


Wearables, Home and Accessories

Services

and cloud services.
